stories.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
stories.summary: The site of the drone strike has been sealed off, as Ukrainian authorities continue their investigation At least 14 people have been killed after a Russian jet-powered drone hit a crowded platform at the main railway station in the central Ukrainian city of Dnipro, local officials have said. Dnipropetrovsk regional head Oleksandr Hanzha said at least 14 others were wounded in the attack, including an 11-year-old boy.

stories.title: Finance ministry estimates India’s Q2 FY27 GDP growth at 7.35%
stories.summary: The finance ministry’s nowcasting model estimates India’s GDP will grow 7.35% in Q2 FY27, following 7.8% growth in the previous quarter, supported by stronger industrial output, energy consumption, port traffic, GST collections and automobile sales.
